name: Sera
title: The Azure Commander

lore.background: The current commander of the Azure Remnant, a regiment descended from the soldiers and refugees who fled the Verdant Vale six centuries ago. Sera did not witness the fall; she inherited its maps, names, burial rolls, and unfinished orders.
lore.the_stagnant_world: Sera lives with the bitter knowledge that Valdris has not needed to hunt the remnant for generations. The enclave survives because it is too small to matter to him while the Fragments keep feeding his immortality. To Sera, that neglect is not mercy. It is proof that her people's history has been reduced to background noise.
lore.the_tragedy: Arren was not her second-in-command, but the founder-martyr of the Azure Remnant: the bridge guard whose stand became the order's first oath and whose corrupted shell became the Void Knight. Sera carries inherited guilt, not personal guilt; every commander before her failed to free him.
lore.mission: Currently protecting a hidden enclave of Verdant Vale descendants in the Crystal Caverns. She is strong by living Aethorian standards, but knows she is nothing against Valdris. She waits for the Summoned ones to provide the spark of defiance her people have preserved, but never possessed alone.
lore.combat_philosophy: Heavy and unyielding. She uses Gravity magic to anchor her enemies to the dying earth, followed by Glacial strikes that shatter the frozen space around them.

narrative_hook: She is the first native Aethorian to recognize the heroes' true purpose. Her presence bridges the gap between the heroes' foreign worlds and Aethoria's inherited grief: not a witness to the fall, but proof that the people who escaped it still exist.
